ModMetaData.name: Faction Tweaks
ModMetaData.author: Shotu
ModMetaData.description:
Faction Tweaks adds additional tools to the world faction selection screen.
Features: - Add Missing Factions: Automatically adds all available factions that are not currently included in the selection. Always adds 1 faction of each. - Random Factions: Randomly generates a faction selection.
Designed to work alongside DLCs and modded factions.
WARNING: This mod is able to remove factions which are "restricted" by other mods like VFE Empire or VFE Deserters. If you want to play with these factions you'll have to add them manually (if removed).
